Title matches "Alice Mburu Scorecard 2026-10-09", period Jul 13–Oct 9 (~13 weeks). 6 dimensions scored -1/+1/+3: Reliability +1→+3, Proactivity +3, Organization +3, Judgment +1→+3, Communication +1→+3, Cultural Fit +3. **Total 18/18, up from 12/18.** Contains 6 graded prior priorities (Met / Met / Not confirmed / Not met as specified / Closed by evidence / Partially met), 6 new growth priorities with measurable targets, and 4 David follow-ups.
